title: The Gift That Saved Iron Man
description: In Iron Man (2008), Pepper Potts keeps Tony Stark's first arc reactor after he replaces it. Here is how that small choice pays off when Obadiah Stane steals the upgrade.
hook: The one thing that could save Iron Man was sitting in a display case.
payoff: Pepper's gift was still in the workshop. The first reactor went back into Tony's chest. The thing he wanted gone saved him again.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: The one thing that could save Iron Man was sitting in a display case.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In the cave, a car battery powered the magnet keeping shrapnel away from Tony's heart.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He built a miniature arc reactor to replace the battery. That little ring could power something bigger.
units.onscreen: TONY BUILDS A NEW POWER SOURCE
units.visual_query: TONY BUILDS A NEW POWER SOURCE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Tony and Yinsen built a suit around it. That first Iron Man armor got Tony out of the cave.
units.onscreen: THE FIRST SUIT GETS HIM OUT
units.visual_query: THE FIRST SUIT GETS HIM OUT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Back home, Tony upgraded the reactor. He told Pepper to throw the old one out. She put it in a display case instead.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then Obadiah Stane pulled the new reactor straight out of Tony's chest and left him to die.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Pepper's gift was still in the workshop. The first reactor went back into Tony's chest. The thing he wanted gone saved him again.
units.onscreen: THE FIRST REACTOR SAVES HIM AGAIN
units.visual_query: THE FIRST REACTOR SAVES HIM AGAIN

units.speaker: Host
units.text: The label said proof that Tony Stark has a heart. Thanks to Pepper, it was still beating.
units.onscreen: PROOF THAT TONY STARK HAS A HEART
units.visual_query: PROOF THAT TONY STARK HAS A HEART
